run_gt_pose_distribution: run the script to calculate and visualize ground truth pose distributions for a BOP dataset
calculate_object_distance_stats: calculate min, max, and mean object distance from camera across all GT poses in a scene
compute_azimuth_elevation: compute azimuth and elevation angles of camera origin in model coordinate system for each GT pose
analyze_visibility_fraction: analyze the visibility fraction statistics of ground truth poses across all scenes in a dataset split
visualize_pose_distributions: generate histogram plots for object distance, azimuth, elevation, and visibility fraction distributions
